name: Live Candlestick Simulator
when_to_pick: The marquee interactive widget for long-form articles: a bot opens and closes trades against a random-walk candlestick series while live stats (trade count, win rate, avg win/loss, net P&L) update tick by tick. It renders a full ghost-preview of the upcoming series at rest, so it looks alive before Play is pressed. Best for explaining strategy expectancy, why win rate varies run-to-run, or how TP/SL/hold rules behave. Pure SVG + JS, no external libraries. Pick this to WATCH trades open and close in real time; for the outcome spread across many runs use monte_carlo_simulator; for the EV map across the win-rate x R:R plane use expectancy_grid.

caption.default: Same bot, same rules. Random price walk — win rate and P&L converge to the strategy's expected value only over many runs.

pair_label.description: Instrument + timeframe label shown under the title, e.g. 'EUR/USD · M5' or 'BTC/USDT · 15m'.
